title: Localhost products restored and verified
summary: Local homepage, boutique, product pages and search now load a read-only snapshot of all 36 published products.

changes.detail: Replaced disconnected preview process with an isolated loopback public-catalog snapshot service. Production source, secrets and database unchanged.
Reusable launch/refresh command and documentation. Catalog snapshot contains public product fields only.
